failed.en-US: Upload failed; the selection is retained

tooLarge.zh-CN: 超出单文件大小限制，请移除或另选文件
tooLarge.en-US: File exceeds the size limit; remove or replace it

wrongType.zh-CN: 不支持此文件类型，请移除或另选文件
wrongType.en-US: Unsupported file type; remove or replace it

tooMany.zh-CN: 附件数量超限，本次选择未上传，请移除多余文件后重试
tooMany.en-US: Too many files; this selection was not uploaded. Remove excess files and retry

resolve.zh-CN: 请逐项重试或移除失败文件后再提交。已成功的文件会保留。
resolve.en-US: Retry or remove each failed file before submitting. Successful files are retained.

staging.zh-CN: 上传不会保存本条业务记录；提交表单时才建立业务关联。
staging.en-US: Uploading does not save this record. Business references are created only when the form is submitted.

invalid.zh-CN: 附件配置或初始值无效，请联系管理员。
invalid.en-US: The attachment configuration or initial value is invalid. Contact an administrator.
